opening.argument: The speaker urges viewers to sign up and deposit $100 within seven days to keep their account, while promoting an average daily profit of 0.5%. That is a direct solicitation to put Bitcoin into an automated trading pool, framed as an attractive opportunity and reinforced by referral commissions and team bonuses for recruiting others. The speaker does acknowledge that returns are not guaranteed, but that qualification does not undo the personal endorsement or the instructions to register and deposit. The central message is an invitation to participate in an investment program promising passive income, with a specific average profit claim and a required deposit.

citations.quote: earn an average of 0.5% daily profit
I really do suggest that you come over, you sign up.
If you don't deposit the $100 within seven days your account will get deleted.
